title.tagline.junior: Explore the lab, do cool experiments, and become the best scientist!
title.tagline.expert: Explore the lab, run experiments, test your theories, and become the best scientist.

title.corrupt.junior: Oops! Your old save got mixed up. We kept a copy just in case, but you'll need to start a new scientist.

title.future.junior: Your save is from a newer version of LabSim. Please refresh or update the game to keep playing it!

title.storageBroken.junior: This device won't let LabSim save. You can still play, but your progress won't be kept.

confirm.newOverwrite.junior: Start a new scientist? Your old scientist and everything they have will be gone forever!

confirm.startOver.junior: Start over? Your scientist and everything they have will be gone forever!

name.tooLong.junior: That name is a little too long!

station.soon.junior: This isn't ready yet. Check back soon!

gizmo.welcome.junior: Hi %s! I'm Gizmo, your robot helper! Walk with the arrow keys or W A S D. On a tablet, drag your finger on the left side of the screen. Press E or tap Use to do things. First, let's visit Dr. Nova in her office. Follow my blue arrow!
gizmo.welcome.expert: Welcome to the lab, %s. I'm Gizmo. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, or drag on the left side of a touch screen. E or Use interacts, M opens the map, B opens your backpack, J hides the job list. Start by visiting Dr. Nova for today's jobs.

tut.paid.junior: You got paid! Crystals show up at the top of the screen. Save them up and spend them at Tom's Shop!

nova.jobs.junior: Good morning, %s! I love having you in the lab. Here are today's jobs:

nova.keepGoing.junior: You still have %d jobs to do today. You can do it! Gizmo's arrow will show you where to go.

nova.allDone.junior: Wow, you finished every job today! You're a real scientist. Come back tomorrow morning for new jobs!

job.delivered.junior: Job done: %s! Here are %d crystals. Thank you!

jobs.none.junior: Visit Dr. Nova to get today's jobs!

animal.butterfly.junior: The butterfly lands on your hand!

animal.axolotl.junior: The axolotl waves its frilly gills!

door.locked.junior: The %s is locked! It costs %d crystals to open. Do jobs to save up!
door.locked.expert: The %s is locked. Unlock cost: %d crystals.

inventory.empty.junior: Your backpack is empty. Grab things you find around the lab!

bag.full.junior: Your backpack is full! Sell things to Tom or get a bigger backpack.

shop.nothing.junior: Nothing here right now. Check back later!

shop.nothingToSell.junior: Your backpack is empty. Find things around the lab and I'll buy them!

tom.hello.junior: Hi there! I'm Tom. I love helping people become better scientists. Sell me things you find, and save up for cool stuff!
tom.hello.expert: Welcome! I'm Tom. Sell me what you find, and invest in tools that unlock harder experiments.

tom.sold.junior: Thanks! Those crystals are yours. Keep exploring!

overlay.close.junior: Tap or press Esc to close

rotate.hint.junior: Turn your device sideways to play!
